__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus or Thanos datasource containing kserve and kserve_vllm metrics

description: KServe AI Platform Usage — infrastructure view of model serving request traffic, latency, token throughput, GPU cache efficiency, and business attribution across clusters. Covers kserve_vllm metrics for vLLM-backed inference services.

panels.title: Total Requests
panels.description: Total successful inference requests in the selected time range across all selected clusters and models

panels.title: Total Tokens Processed
panels.description: Sum of prompt + generation tokens consumed across all selected models and clusters

targets.expr: sum(increase(kserve_vllm:request_prompt_tokens_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model_name", lob=~"$lob"}[$__range])) + sum(increase(kserve_vllm:request_generation_tokens_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model_name", lob=~"$lob"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Current Request Rate
panels.description: Requests per second at current time across selected filters

panels.title: Active Models
panels.description: Number of distinct model names currently serving requests

panels.title: P99 Time to First Token
panels.description: 99th percentile TTFT across all selected models and clusters

panels.title: P99 Time Per Output Token
panels.description: 99th percentile inter-token latency (TPOT) across selected models

panels.title: GPU KV Cache Utilization
panels.description: Average GPU KV cache usage across selected clusters and models. High values indicate the cache is near capacity.

panels.title: Queued Requests
panels.description: Total number of requests currently waiting in queue across all selected models

panels.title: Request Rate by Cluster
panels.description: Inference requests per second broken down by cluster. Compare load across clusters to identify imbalances.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (rate(kserve_vllm:request_success_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model_name", lob=~"$lob", app_id=~"$app_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Request Rate by Model
panels.description: Inference requests per second per model. Identifies most popular models and demand distribution across the AI portfolio.

targets.expr: sum by (model_name) (rate(kserve_vllm:request_success_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model_name", lob=~"$lob", app_id=~"$app_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Token Throughput — Prompt vs Generation
panels.description: Tokens per second ingested (prompt) vs generated (output). A high prompt:generation ratio may indicate short responses or chat use cases. A low ratio indicates long-form generation.

targets.expr: sum(rate(kserve_vllm:request_prompt_tokens_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model_name", lob=~"$lob"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(kserve_vllm:request_generation_tokens_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model_name", lob=~"$lob"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Token Throughput by Model
panels.description: Total tokens/s (prompt + generation) broken down by model. Indicates which models are consuming the most compute.

targets.expr: sum by (model_name) (rate(kserve_vllm:request_prompt_tokens_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model_name", lob=~"$lob"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (model_name) (rate(kserve_vllm:request_generation_tokens_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model_name", lob=~"$lob"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Time to First Token (TTFT) — Percentiles
panels.description: How quickly the model starts generating output after receiving a request. P50/P90/P99 breakdown. High values indicate GPU contention or long prefill times on large prompts.

panels.title: Time Per Output Token (TPOT) — Percentiles
panels.description: Inter-token generation latency (decoding speed). Higher values reduce streaming responsiveness. Target varies by model size — larger models naturally have higher TPOT.

panels.title: Request Queue Time — Percentiles
panels.description: Time spent waiting in queue before GPU execution begins. Sustained high queue times indicate the cluster is oversubscribed — requests are arriving faster than they can be processed.

panels.title: TTFT by Model (P99)
panels.description: P99 Time to First Token broken down per model. Compares responsiveness across models — useful for capacity planning and SLA reporting.

panels.title: TPOT by Model (P99)
panels.description: P99 inter-token latency per model. A rising TPOT under load indicates decode throughput is being shared across concurrent requests (batching).

panels.title: Active Requests — Running vs Waiting
panels.description: Number of requests currently being processed (running) vs queued (waiting). A growing wait queue while running is flat signals capacity limits. Swapped requests were evicted from GPU to CPU.

panels.title: Concurrent Requests by Model
panels.description: Running requests per model. Shows which models dominate concurrent compute slots — relevant for GPU sharing and resource reservation planning.

panels.title: GPU KV Cache Utilization by Model
panels.description: Fraction of GPU KV cache blocks in use. Values near 100% mean new requests cannot be batched efficiently and will trigger preemptions. Target: sustained < 85%.

panels.title: Prefix Cache Hit Rate
panels.description: GPU prefix (prompt) cache hit rate. Higher values mean repeated prompt prefixes are being reused, reducing TTFT and GPU compute. Low values may indicate diverse, non-repetitive prompts or cache eviction pressure.

panels.title: CPU KV Cache Utilization by Model
panels.description: CPU KV cache usage fraction. Non-zero values indicate requests have been swapped out of GPU memory to CPU — a sign of memory pressure. Sustained CPU cache usage degrades throughput significantly.

panels.title: Request Share by Line of Business
panels.description: Distribution of inference requests by LOB label. Shows which business units are the primary consumers of the AI platform.

targets.expr: sum by (lob) (increase(kserve_vllm:request_success_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model_name", lob=~"$lob", app_id=~"$app_id"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Token Consumption by Line of Business
panels.description: Total tokens (prompt + generation) consumed per LOB. A more accurate cost proxy than request count — large-context applications show higher token volumes per request.

targets.expr: sum by (lob) (increase(kserve_vllm:request_prompt_tokens_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model_name", lob=~"$lob"}[$__range])) + sum by (lob) (increase(kserve_vllm:request_generation_tokens_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model_name", lob=~"$lob"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Requests by Use Case
panels.description: Request volume per use_case label over the selected window. Reveals which workflows are driving AI platform demand.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (use_case) (increase(kserve_vllm:request_success_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model_name", lob=~"$lob", app_id=~"$app_id"}[$__range])))

panels.title: App ID Usage Summary
panels.description: Per-app_id breakdown of request volume, token consumption, and average request rate. Sort by Total Tokens to identify the highest-cost applications. Use to drive chargeback conversations with business units.

targets.expr: sum by (app_id, lob) (increase(kserve_vllm:request_success_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model_name", lob=~"$lob", app_id=~"$app_id"}[$__range]))

sum by (app_id) (increase(kserve_vllm:request_prompt_tokens_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", app_id=~"$app_id", lob=~"$lob"}[$__range])) + sum by (app_id) (increase(kserve_vllm:request_generation_tokens_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", app_id=~"$app_id", lob=~"$lob"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Model Performance Summary
panels.description: Per-model comparison of request volume, token throughput, P99 latencies, and GPU cache efficiency. Use to identify models that are under-served (high TTFT, full cache) or underutilized (low req/s, low cache).

panels.title: Request Outcomes by Finished Reason
panels.description: Breakdown of how requests completed: stop (natural end), length (hit max_tokens), abort (client cancelled), error (server-side failure). High abort or error rates indicate client timeout issues or model instability.

targets.expr: sum by (finished_reason) (rate(kserve_vllm:request_success_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", model_name=~"$model_name", lob=~"$lob", app_id=~"$app_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests Truncated at max_tokens (length)
panels.description: Rate of requests that hit the max_tokens limit. High rates suggest callers are setting insufficient generation limits, which may cause incomplete responses and poor user experience.

panels.title: Preemptions Over Time
panels.description: Number of times requests were preempted (evicted from GPU KV cache and re-queued). Preemptions reduce effective throughput. Sustained preemptions indicate insufficient GPU memory for the current batch size / model configuration.

title: KServe AI Platform Usage
